question: Should OpenClaw support native per-task model hints in HEARTBEAT.md, or should heartbeat model routing remain per-turn and be handled by plugins or scheduled-job routing?
rationale: Current source proves the requested task-level boundary is missing, but implementing it would set public syntax and provider/session precedence that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Fold into scheduled routing first
options.body: Use the open cron/job-level model override design as the canonical scheduled-model-routing contract before adding another HEARTBEAT.md-specific syntax.

options.title: Add native HEARTBEAT.md hints
options.body: Define model/provider fields on task blocks, group or split due tasks by effective model, and add docs/tests for validation, timestamps, and session restoration.

options.title: Keep routing plugin-owned
options.body: Document that heartbeat ticks are one model-routed turn today and steer task-dependent routing to before_model_resolve or ClawHub plugins unless a missing core seam is proven.

recommendation.title: Fold into scheduled routing first
recommendation.body: Use the open cron/job-level model override design as the canonical scheduled-model-routing contract before adding another HEARTBEAT.md-specific syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the original heartbeat task batching commit as committer and to prior model-routing product-scope decisions.
